title: Reproducibility package for Pressure-Robust and Exactly Divergence-Free Mixed Finite Elements for Unsteady Thermally Coupled Brinkman--Forchheimer Flow
description: FEniCSx reproducibility package for an exactly divergence-free, pressure-robust BDM--DG/SIP and BDF2 discretization of an unsteady thermally coupled convective Brinkman--Forchheimer system. The archive contains manufactured convergence data, mass-conservation diagnostics, direct gradient-force pressure-robustness tests, fixed-mesh BDF2 temporal convergence tests, and complex-domain nonlinear-drag simulations.
